summary: The miniature is recognizable: cream siding, dark layered gables, two front dormers, chimney, broad divided-window frontage, and an offset covered entry form a coherent, charming cottage caricature. The taller rear mass is somewhat visually dominant but remains compatible with the aerial’s layered roof form.

orientation.summary: SV3 is geolocated ENE of the building and looks southwest onto the +v face; it clearly shows the principal door left of the broad window group beneath the covered porch. The rendered blueprint inventory has its sole door on that same +v/ENE face toward Pratt Avenue. The +v panel likewise presents this entrance frontage, with no duplicated principal portal on another face.

issues.problem: The +v entrance reads more like a glazed box than the reference’s open, left-offset porch with conspicuous timber rails and ramp.
issues.fix: Open up the porch sides and strengthen the pale rail/ramp silhouette while retaining the existing +v door.
